rules.label: The business
rules.rule: The company's numbers don't argue against the side.

rules.label: The market
rules.rule: Market wind is not against the side.

rules.label: The pattern
rules.rule: Line-chart reversal + engulfing on the daily chart or higher.

rules.label: Second opinion
rules.rule: Wyckoff (Phase C / spring) or ICT (sweep, break, retest, live) agrees.

rules.label: Entry is live
rules.rule: Price is in the entry zone now and the trigger has fired.

rules.label: The payoff
rules.rule: Target 1 pays at least 2× the risk, from levels on the chart.

rules.label: The money
rules.rule: No earnings within 7 days; insiders not trading against it.
